name: Lemon Sponge
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Strain lemon juice on the sugar
Beat the yolks of the eggs and mix with the remainder of the water, having used a half cupful of the pint in which to soak the gelatine
Add the sugar and lemon to this and cook until it begins to thicken
Strain this into a basin, which place in a pan of water to cool
Beat with a whisk until it has cooled but not hardened
Add the whites of the eggs until it begins to thicken
Turn in a mold and set to harden
Serve with powdered sugar and cream

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Strain lemon juice on the sugar
2. Beat the yolks of the eggs and mix with the remainder of the water, having used a half cupful of the pint in which to soak the gelatine
3. Add the sugar and lemon to this and cook until it begins to thicken
4. Add the gelatine
5. Strain this into a basin, which place in a pan of water to cool
6. Beat with a whisk until it has cooled but not hardened
7. Add the whites of the eggs until it begins to thicken
8. Turn in a mold and set to harden
9. Serve with powdered sugar and cream
